topic: Cash envelope budget vs swiping every card (Wade vs Piper)

scenes.narration: Cash spenders save eighteen percent more than card swipers. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding three envelopes labeled GROCERIES, GAS, FUN, comic burst banner reads CASH WINS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Wade and Piper both budget two thousand dollars a month for variables.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man wade and woman piper each holding budget sheets labeled TWO THOUSAND VARIABLE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That covers groceries, gas, and entertainment for the whole month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, three icons labeled GROCERIES GAS ENTERTAINMENT lined up under a TWO THOUSAND label, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Wade swipes a credit card for every variable expense.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, wade at a grocery checkout swiping a credit card, receipt curling out of the register, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He tells himself he will check the total at month end.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, wade tossing a receipt into a drawer with a thought bubble reading CHECK LATER, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Piper pulls cash on payday into three labeled envelopes.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, piper at a kitchen counter splitting cash into envelopes labeled GROCERIES GAS FUN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: When an envelope is empty, that category is closed entirely.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a small chalkboard reading ENVELOPE EMPTY EQUALS NO MORE, an empty envelope beside it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Wade's monthly card statement shows two thousand four hundred dollars spent.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked wade at a kitchen table looking at a card statement reading TWO THOUSAND FOUR HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He went four hundred dollars over budget again this month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a comic banner reads FOUR HUNDRED OVER AGAIN, wade rubbing his temples, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Piper finished the month with thirty dollars in fun money.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, piper holding an envelope labeled FUN with thirty dollars still inside, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She had zero credit card balance and full cash control.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, piper smiling at a clean card statement stamped ZERO BALANCE beside her three envelopes, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Use cash envelopes where you overspend. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing a whistle, holding three envelopes labeled GROCERIES GAS FUN, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
